result.description: `applied` — pre-image hash matched and bytes changed. `stale_base` — `expected_hash` did not match the observed pre-image. `no_op` — pre-image hash matched but the post-image is identical to the pre-image, so the write was skipped.

current_hash.description: `sha256:HEX` of the observed pre-image. Echoed even on `stale_base` so the caller can re-read and retry without an extra hop.
